content: Yuhuda Kawo Minaase
Minaasey kawotiza wode izas layththay 12; izi Yerusalaamen uttidi 55 layth haarides; iza aaya Hafeseebo geetettawus.
Minaasey GODAY Isra7eele sinththafe gooddi kessida harassiza kawoteththata lose kaallidi GODAA sinththan iita ooso ooththides.

Kase iza aawa Hizqiyaasi zumbullata bolla diza eeqa xoossata keeth laallidayssa zaari keexxides; Isra7eele kawo Akaabey ooththoyssaththo izikka Ba7aales yarsho yarshizaso giigsides. Asheeri misle tuus essides; hessaththoka salo xoolinttetaska goynnides.
GODAY, «Tani ta sunththaa Yerusalaamen woththana» gida Xoossa Keeththan yarshota yarshizasohota ooththides.
Xoossa Keeththa zago nam7atan salo xoolinttetas goynnanasohota giigsides.
Ba naaza xuugettiza yarsho histti shiishshides; histtidi muurennizayta, marota, moytille haasayssizaytanne ayana kaayizayta zore oychchides; GODAA hanqeththiza iita hanota iza sinththan ooththides.

Izi ba massi giigsida Asheeri misleza Xoossa Keeththa giddon woththides. Hessika GODAY kase Dawite naa Solomoones, «Tani hayssa Xoossa Keeththaninne Isra7eele qommota ubbata garsafe doorida Yerusalaamen ta sunththaa mernaas heen woththana.

Gidikkoka tani istta azazidayssa ubbaaka istti minni polettonne ta aylle Musey kase isttas immida wogaza istti poli naagetto attiin hayssafe guye Isra7eele asaa kase istta aawatas immida biittafe istti kezidi waayettana mala ta ooththike» gida qaalay hayssa ha sohoza gishshassa.
Derezi gidikko hessa siyibeenna; kase GODAY dhayssida kawoteththatappekka bollara istti iita ooththana mala Minaasey asaa baleththides.
GODAY ba aylle nabeta baggara hizgi yootides;
«Yuhuda kawo Minaasey hayssa shuunniza iita nagara ooththides; izi kase baappe kase diza Amoore dere asaappeka bollara iita ooththides. Yuhuda asaakka eeqatan baleththides.
Hessa gishshas GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay siyidaade hayththas iitiza meto tani Yerusalaame bollanne Yuhuda bolla yeddana.
Tani Samaariyas giigsida wadha wodoro, tani Akaabeso izara ginasa xeellida tumbezakka Yerusalaame bolla yeddana; asi saane meecci gufanththiza mala tanikka Yerusalaame meecca dhayssana.
Casha attida ta xinxxota tani aggana; tani istta istta morkketas aaththa immana; istti ba morkketas di7o miish gidana.
Tani hessaththo ooththiza gaasoykka istti kase ba aawati Gibxeppe kezoosofe hanno gakkanaas istti ta sinththan iita ooso ooththidi tana hanqos denththeththida gishshassa» gides.
Harappeka Minaasey Yuhuda asay Xoossa sinththan iita ooththana mala istti nagara oosisida nagaraappe harakka Yerusalaames ha gaxappe he gaxa gakkanaas xillo gidida daro asaa suuth gussides.
Minaase kawoteththa wode hanida hara miish ba ooththida nagaraa bolla gujjidi izi ooththiday ubbay Yuhuda Kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetti dees gidennee?
Minaasey kase ba aawata mala hayqqides; izi Ooza atakilte giddon diza duufon moogettides; iza naazi Amooneykka izasohon kawotides.
Yuhuda Kawo Amoone
Amooney kawotishin izas layththay 22; izi Yerusalaamen uttidi 2 layth haarides. Iza aaya Mesolamo geetettawus; iza Yaxiba dere as Haruse naa.
Iza aawa Minaasey ooththoyssaththo izikka GODAA sinththan iita miish ooththides.
Kase ba aaway bida ogezara izikka bides; kase ba aaway goynnida eeqa xoossatas goynnidessinne isttas hokki gulbatides.
Kase ba GODAA Xoossa aggaagides; izi GODAA ogen bibeenna.
Amoone dere shuumeti makkallida; kawozakka kawoteththa keeththa giddon wodhida.
Hessafe guye he dere asay kawo Amoone bolla dendidi iza wodhides; iza naaza Iyosiyaasakka izasohon kawoththida.
Amooney kawoti diza wode hanida hara oosoy izi poliday ubbayka Yuhuda Kawota Taarike Maxaafatan xaafetti dees gidennee?
Izi Ooza atakilte giddon diza duufon moogettides; iza naazi Iyosiyaasi izasohon kawotides.
